# Pexels Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill that searches Pexels's library of free stock media: search photos, search videos, and list curated collections, returning thumbnails and direct links to the real files. Fully read-only — nothing is uploaded, changed, or billed. Honest note: the Pexels API key itself is free, but it is rate-limited (roughly 200 requests per hour and ~20,000 per month); stay inside those quotas. Pexels media is free to use commercially under the Pexels license — keep the photographer's credit line when you publish. Draft: written from Pexels's public API docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — this listing's unverified status reflects that. No secrets in the repo.
